نعترض (form VIII)
# نَعْتَرِضُ (naʕtariḍu) /naʕ.ta.ri.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# نُعْتَرَضُ (nuʕtaraḍu) /nuʕ.ta.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# نَعْتَرِضَ (naʕtariḍa) /naʕ.ta.ri.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# نُعْتَرَضَ (nuʕtaraḍa) /nuʕ.ta.ra.dˤ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
